title: Apply TRS rotation to per-step UV deltas in LyonMetrics
description: On Hand-30k synthetic q=1 the LyonMetrics dmax reports 90.0° — suspicious. Cause: TArc.stepUvs stores per-step (uIn, vIn, uOut, vOut) in each step's local face frame, but consecutive steps cross face boundaries and need a TRS (transition rotation+translation) applied so adjacent UVs are in a common frame before computing tangent direction. Without TRS application, a step that's actually +u in its local frame can appear orthogonal once it crosses a seam edge. Fix: thread CombedField/TransitionMatrix into LyonMetrics.compute, apply TRS to each step's exit point before computing direction. Also relevant if we ever do 3D arc tangents.
definition-of-done: Hand-30k dmax drops below 90° on synthetic q=1; ideally < 10° matching Lyon's TEST1/SCULPT entries (dmax=3-17°).
testing-plan: Add a 1-arc fixture that crosses a synthetic seam edge with a known rotation; verify deviation reads 0° not 90°.
